newsitem.title: USA: Hilton extends ITT tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Hilton extends ITT tender offer.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp. said Friday it extended its $6.5 billion hostile cash offer for hotel and casino giant ITT Corp. for another month.
In a statemment, Hilton said the offer to acquire 50.1 percent of ITT shares at $55 apiece is now due to expire on Aug. 1, unless the company extends it again.
So far about 1.3 million ITT shares have been tendered as of Friday, the previous deadline.

ITT owns Sheraton hotels and Caesars World casinos. Hilton launched its bid for ITT in January, but ITT quickly rejected the offer and has sold a number of non-core assets, including its stake in Madison Square Garden, to focus on its main hotel and gaming operations.
ITT has about 122.7 million shares on a fully diluted basis, giving the deal a total value of about $6.5 billion.
ITT stock rose 12.5 cents to $59.69 and Hilton added 19 cents to $27.44 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
